title: LikenessAdapter
description: LIKENESS-01. Who a saved style (LoRA) in the household library looks like, declared when it was added. subject_person_id is a household adult whose consent was on at that moment, or null for "Nobody (not a real person)". A style of a minor or of anyone who is not a consenting household adult is refused at import and never has a record. A subject-linked style is always adult-only and is usable only while the subject's consent is on; when the consent goes off the record moves to removal_queued and the style is removed from the library.

adapter_id.description: The style's id in the Stack's library for this medium.

subject_person_id.description: The household adult this style looks like, or null for nobody.

classification.description: The style's audience. Always adult-only when subject_person_id is set.

declared_by.description: The adult who added the style and answered "Who does this style look like?".

source.description: How the record came to be; this is the record provenance.
